text: Order Service writes the PENDING order and the OrderPlaced outbox row in one transaction and returns 202 Accepted with the order ID. The request handler does not publish to the broker.

The relay polls every 500 ms, publishes unsent rows oldest first and marks a row sent only after the broker ack. The artifact makes clear that this gives at-least-once delivery, so duplicates can occur.

Events travel on the topic order-events, keyed by order ID. Inventory, Payment and Notification each have their own consumer group and database, and the artifact shows how duplicate events are handled safely.

The card is charged only after stock is reserved. The artifact shows the happy path and both cancellation paths: not enough stock (no charge, order cancelled) and card declined (reservation released, order cancelled).
Only Order Service sets the order status, and the final statuses are CONFIRMED and CANCELLED.
A card decline is handled as a business result and a card-provider timeout or 5xx as an error, and the artifact shows how a repeated charge request avoids charging the card twice.

A failing message is retried after 1 s, 10 s and 60 s, then sent to that group's dead-letter queue with on-call paged, and the order status is not changed. Email failures never change the order status.
The artifact is a Mermaid sequenceDiagram with short notes before or after it.
